recipe_version.title: Pan-Fried Trout with Lemon and Capers
recipe_version.description: Trout fillets pan-fried in olive oil, with a lemon and caper pan sauce made with vegetable broth. No butter.

ingredients.name: trout
ingredients.note: about 6 oz each, skin on or off

ingredients.name: lemon
ingredients.preparation: juiced, about 3 tbsp, plus the rind left for the plate

ingredients.name: vegetable broth
ingredients.note: dairy-free, with no chicken and no fish

steps.title: Dredge the trout
steps.body: Pat the trout dry, salt and pepper it, and dredge lightly in the flour. Juice the lemon, mince the garlic, and chop the parsley. About 10 minutes.

steps.title: Pan-fry the trout
steps.body: Heat the olive oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Pan-fry the trout in two batches, about 3 minutes on the floured side and 1 to 2 minutes on the second side, until golden and 145 F. Move the fillets to a plate.

steps.title: Make the pan sauce
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium. Add the garlic and stir 30 seconds. Add the capers, lemon juice, and vegetable broth. Simmer about 2 minutes until the sauce tastes bright and is still thin. Take it off the heat, stir in the parsley, and spoon it over the trout. About 6 minutes. Cook total is 14.
